diagnostics: This run intentionally ignored prior conversation sector shortlist as an answer source and rescanned broad industries.
Profit-chain radar is not truncated by final stock shortlist; weak/mixed chains are retained to make exclusions auditable.
Power equipment is a key correction: broad NBS electrical-machinery profit is weak, while listed-company grid/UHV and lithium-related subchains are strong.
Chemical industry is decomposed into multiple distinct chains rather than refrigerant/spandex only.

Some active chains such as storage chips, optical modules, lithium battery cells and paper still lack enough directly comparable main-board names for a high-confidence best-company conclusion; they remain in radar rather than being silently dropped.
All valuation multiples are Shadow model judgments, not universal finance laws; stability across repeated runs must be monitored.
No formal production buy point is published because mode remains shadow.
